gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: symptoms present for 8 weeks. Generated HPI-001: 'For the past two months' ≈ 8 weeks; duration and context (ongoing symptoms) are captured.
Gold: not able to get up in the morning. Generated HPI-001/CC-001: difficulty getting/waking up in the morning; same symptom described.
Gold: no energy during the day. Generated HPI-001/ROS-001: lack/reduced energy during the day; equivalent concept (fatigue/low energy).
Gold: not eating. Generated HPI-003: reduced appetite; conveys decreased intake, consistent with not eating well.
Gold: difficulty sleeping. Generated HPI-004 and ROS-007: trouble/difficulty sleeping; same symptom.
Gold: mood is distracted, difficulty focusing. Generated HPI-007/HPI-008 and ROS-004/ROS-005: difficulty focusing and easily distracted; this captures 'distracted mood with difficulty focusing.'
Gold: lower mood recently. Generated HPI-006 and ROS-002: mood lower than usual; same content.
Gold: decreased sex drive. Generated HPI-005, ROS-003, ASM-001/ASM-003: decreased sex drive is explicitly documented.
Gold: patient denies suicidal ideation. No generated fact mentions suicidal ideation; this denial is not represented.
Gold: shortness of breath on exertion. Generated HPI-010, ROS-006, ASM-005/ASM-006: shortness of breath with physical activity/exertion; equivalent description of exertional dyspnea.
Gold: hypothyroidism. Generated PMH-001: history of hypothyroidism; identical condition.
Gold: takes thyroxine. Generated MED-001: taking thyroxine; same medication.
Gold: NKDA. Generated ALLERGY-001: no known drug allergies; same information.
Gold: father died by suicide. Generated FH-001: father committed suicide 15 years ago; same event with added timing.
Gold: mother is well. No generated fact states mother's health status; only 'no other significant family history' which doesn’t explicitly say the mother is well.
Gold: no brothers or sisters. Generated facts do not mention siblings; this is absent.
Gold: patient is married. Generated SH-001: married for many years; confirms marital status with extra duration detail.
Gold: new job 2 months ago. Generated HPI-002 and ASM-001 context: started a new job two months ago; same timeline and event.

Gold: clinical impression includes depression (as a working impression). Generated ASM-002 lists depression as a differential diagnosis but not explicitly as an impression/assessment; therefore the explicit impression of depression is not captured.

Gold: impression includes hypothyroidism with low T3/T4. Generated notes list hypothyroidism only in PMH and as a differential in ASM-002, but not as an assessment of 'hypothyroidism with low T3/T4'; this specific impression is missing.
Gold: order TSH. Generated PLAN-001 mentions blood tests to evaluate thyroid function but does not explicitly list TSH or specific test names; the discrete order 'TSH' is not directly represented.

Gold: order FBC. Generated PLAN-001 mentions a complete blood count, which is equivalent to FBC, but as part of a generic 'evaluate' set rather than a clear specific order; however, the question is about whether the gold fact is captured. Since 'complete blood count' = FBC, this is conceptually present but described more broadly. To be rigorous about matching explicit orders vs generalized evaluation, this is borderline; however, content-wise the same test is named and planned. Therefore this should be considered COVERED.
Gold: arrange GP review. Generated PLAN-002: advised to see his GP for further assessment; same disposition.

This assessment text summarizes fatigue, low energy, decreased appetite, low mood, decreased sex drive. While all symptoms are supported by various gold HPI facts, packaging them as an assessment item for 'past two months' coinciding with a new job is a synthesized narrative, not present as an assessment in the gold standard.
Differential of depression and hypothyroidism is supported by gold impressions (asm-001, asm-002). Sleep disorder is not mentioned in gold; thus part is supported and part is an addition.

Decreased sex drive associated with low mood over the last few months is consistent with gold reporting of decreased sex drive and lower mood; 'last few months' is slightly broader than 8 weeks but not contradictory—additional nuance.

Differential for decreased sex drive: depression is consistent with gold impression of depression, but 'hormonal imbalance' is not specified in gold; the overall differential list is not present in the gold assessment.
Assessment of new onset SOB with activity is consistent with gold SOB on exertion; 'new onset, affecting previous activities' is extra detail but not conflicting.
Differential of cardiopulmonary issue and deconditioning for SOB is not mentioned in gold; this is added clinical reasoning.

Recommending in-person consultation and a broad panel (thyroid function, CBC, metabolic panel) goes beyond gold, which only specifies TSH and FBC. Parts overlap conceptually but the construct and metabolic panel are additional.
